BrochureContent.Content:
Sheehy Meares Team McCullagh are delighted to present to the market this charming detached residence set on approximately 1.43 acres in a peaceful rural location just minutes from Portumna town.

Offering an excellent opportunity to acquire a home full of character and potential, this four-bedroom property has been extended over the years to provide spacious and versatile accommodation. The home benefits from oil-fired central heating and features a welcoming living room with a solid fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The accommodation comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms, a family bathroom, and comfortable living areas, making it an ideal choice for families or those seeking a countryside lifestyle with convenient access to local amenities.

Located just a five-minute drive from Portumna town centre, the property enjoys close proximity to a full range of services including primary and secondary schools, shops, cafés, sporting facilities, and everyday conveniences.

Standing on a generous site of approximately 1.43 acres, the property offers excellent outdoor space with ample room for gardening, recreation, or future enhancement, subject to any necessary planning permissions.

Services include water supply, septic tank, and ESB electricity.

This attractive property combines rural tranquillity with convenience and presents a wonderful opportunity for purchasers seeking a home with space, charm, and further potential.

BER Rating: D2

Viewing is highly recommended and can be arranged strictly by appointment through the selling agent.
